/bin/bash -lc "PYTHONPATH=src python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from rz_data.io import read_json
from rz_data.serialization import canonical_bytes
from rz_training.trainer import train_fixture,verify_export
p=Path('fixtures/training')
out=Path('${ARTIFACT_ROOT}/original-f02')
recipe=read_json(p/'recipe.json',max_bytes=65536)
source=Path.cwd().parents[1]
def run(name,**kw):
    return train_fixture(recipe,p/'manifest.json',p/'records.jsonl',p/'split-plan.json',p/'features.json',output_root=out,run_id=name,source_root=source,**kw)
full,full_r=run('cpu-continuous-v1')
paused,pause_r=run('cpu-pause-v1',stop_after=3)
resumed,resume_r=run('cpu-resume-v1',resume_path=paused/'resume-checkpoint.json')
a=read_json(full/'resume-checkpoint.json',max_bytes=1048576)
b=read_json(resumed/'resume-checkpoint.json',max_bytes=1048576)
checks={k:a[k]==b[k] for k in ('model','optimizer','sampler','best','history')}
assert all(checks.values())
recipe['freeze']=True
(out/'frozen-recipe-v1.json').write_bytes(canonical_bytes(recipe)+b'\\n')
frozen,frozen_r=run('cpu-frozen-v1')
assert not frozen_r['weights_changed'] and frozen_r['selection']['step']==0
summary={'continuous_steps':full_r['actual']['steps'],'paused_steps':pause_r['actual']['steps'],'resumed_steps':resume_r['actual']['steps'],'resume_matches':checks,'weights_changed':full_r['weights_changed'],'validation_loss_first':full_r['history'][0]['validation_loss'],'validation_loss_last':full_r['history'][-1]['validation_loss'],'frozen_weights_changed':frozen_r['weights_changed'],'export':verify_export(read_json(resumed/'export.json',max_bytes=1048576)),'digests':{'full_receipt':full_r['digest'],'resume_receipt':resume_r['digest'],'frozen_receipt':frozen_r['digest'],'final_model':full_r['final_weights_digest']}}
(out/'cpu-lifecycle-summary-v1.json').write_bytes(canonical_bytes(summary)+b'\\n')
print(canonical_bytes(summary).decode())
PY"
